messages.text: Choose exactly one admissible typed tool using the observations. Tool execution success is not goal completion. A partial inspection requires a valid reachable inspection viewpoint, then another inspection. Instance- bound goals must never substitute a different candidate. If verification fails, consider the admissible alternatives. Finish true only if verdict.satisfied; finish false when no safe admissible alternatives remain. No raw motor commands. Repeated actions are bounded.
